svg.title: Scale Formation - Flow Diagram
svg.desc: Geothermal fluid rises → pressure/temperature change. Pressure falls → CO₂ release → pH rises → carbonate concentration rises → supersaturated calcium carbonate precipitates → pipe-wall scale. Temperature falls → silica solubility falls → silicic-acid polymerisation → colloidal silica deposition → scale. Corrosion products/microorganisms provide nucleation sites. Key: CO₂逸出 = CO₂ release; 硅酸聚合 = silicic-acid polymerisation; 附着管壁成垢 = pipe-wall deposition; 提供成核位点 = provide nucleation sites.
